description: Cheapen the sign-DC per-matrix cuSOLVER FALLBACK path, which a sibling measured costs ~4ms each (n=512 cuSOLVER syevd + a serialized af[idx] row-gather) and is the multiplier gating how tight the reduced-block K can go: at K=296 there are 0 fallbacks, but the ~4ms/fallback cost is what forces K to stay at the 0-fallback floor rather than dropping further (K=292 → 1 fallback, 288 → 5). Mechanism: replace the fallback's whole-n=512 cuSOLVER syevd with a cheaper route for the rare wide-split matrices (the existing sign-DC path at a larger K bucket, or a batched cuSOLVER call over the fallback set instead of per-matrix), and fuse/vectorize the af[idx] gather (currently serialized). If the fallback is cheap, K can drop below 296 and mega_eigh+trsm shrink quadratically for the whole batch. Targets the fallback-path redundant-work multiplier; keep the residual gate, route guarded per shape.

PROFILE fallback path + env-gated instrumentation (SIGNDC_FBTIME, SIGNDC_K). Clean geomean 26385.9us (parent 26369, noise), shape11 68216us, shape5 89301us untouched, 39/39, kernelguard CLEAN. MEASURED: af[idx] gather NEGLIGIBLE (0.045ms@5fb, 0.105ms@210fb); ENTIRE fallback cost is torch.linalg.eigh which is ALREADY batched (210 matrices=78ms=0.375ms/matrix marginal). Cost = ~24ms FIXED per-CALL cuSOLVER n=512 syevd overhead (fit 24.1ms+0.258ms*nfb). K=288 5-6fb=25.4ms; K=272 210fb=78.3ms. nsys: sytrd4_cta 7.4ms + 898 gemvx + laed/steqr, zero TC. Batching is NOT the lever (already batched); the fixed per-call cuSOLVER overhead is.

WIDE-K RECOVERY (full sign-DC re-solve) for residual-failed subset; primary K 296->288, recover_K=344. Recovery resolves ALL ~5 failures (still_bad=0, cuSOLVER never fires), cost ~8.5ms steady vs ~25ms cuSOLVER floor. NET REGRESSED: geomean 26501 (parent 26369, +0.5%), shape11 74210us (parent 68216, +6ms) -- the 296->288 mega_eigh+trsm saving (~4ms) < the ~8.5ms full-resolve recovery cost paid every iteration. Full re-solve recomputes X from scratch (power+ns_sign dominate). 39/39, kernelguard CLEAN. NEXT: reuse the primary X (run only stages 3-8) to cut recovery to ~2-3ms.

X-REUSE recovery: recovery reuses primary sign X (stages 3-8 only via new _sign_dc_finish_from_sign). K=288, recover_K=344. Recovery resolves ALL failures (still_bad=0), cost ~7.5ms/5 matrices (vs full-resolve 8.5ms) -- only marginally cheaper: at tiny batch stages 1-2 already cheap, the 7.5ms is stages 3-8 fixed per-call overhead (n=512 GEMMs + ~20 dependent launches, latency-bound). Clean geomean 26544 (parent 26369), shape11 73296us (+5ms). STILL NET-NEGATIVE at K=288 (296->288 saving ~2ms << 7.5ms recovery). 39/39, CLEAN. NEXT: sweep K=280/272 (saving grows quadratically); trim recovery finish passes + smaller recover_K.

Cheapen recovery: recover_K 344->320 + recovery-knob overrides (CQR/final_ns threaded through, default 2/2 = byte-identical primary). SWEEP at K=288 (~5fb): recover_K=320 CQR=2 fns=2 -> 6.8ms still_bad=0 (adopted); CQR=2 fns=1 -> still_bad=1; CQR=1 -> fails ALL. CQR=2 AND final=2 both load-bearing (CholeskyQR2 + 2 finish passes needed to clear orth gate); recover_K 344->320 saves 0.7ms but passes can't drop -> recovery floor ~6.5-7ms. CLEAN K=288 recover_K=320: shape11 72594us (parent 68216, +4.4ms), geomean 26523. STILL NET-NEGATIVE: recovery floor ~6.8ms >> ~2ms/8-K-step saving. 39/39, CLEAN, stream absent.

PROFILE recovery cost breakdown (prefixed stage timers + nsys). K=288 recover_K=320. Recovery breakdown (~5 matrices): rec_5_mega_eigh=4.5ms DOMINANT (reduced 320x320 eigh megakernel, 10 CTAs on 148 SMs, 93% idle), rec_3_proj_cqr=1.8ms, rec_7_finish_ns=1.5-2ms, rest <0.4ms; total ~7.6ms. nsys confirms mega_eigh_med_split_k = 2 instances (primary 21.7ms/1280 CTAs + recovery 4.2ms/10 CTAs). The megakernel is ONE-CTA-PER-MATRIX + ONE-K-PER-LAUNCH with a ~4.5ms fixed latency floor per launch (in-kernel tridiag+D&C, underfilled at low batch), so ANY wider-K subset needs its own +4.5ms launch >> the ~2ms per-8-K-step saving. Structural wall (same as brief-117's 2-bucket +5.1ms). Clean K=288 72718us. 39/39, CLEAN, stream absent.

TEST batched-cuSOLVER reduced-eigh for recovery (reduced_eigh_mode knob, default None=megakernel). 'cusolver' mode on the K x K=320x320 recovery blocks: rec_5_mega_eigh 4.5ms->18.14ms, total recovery 6.8ms->21.5ms -- WORSE. cuSOLVER on 10 blocks of 320x320 hits the same fixed-overhead wall; the megakernel (one-CTA-per-matrix in-SMEM eigh) is 4x faster even at tiny batch, so 4.5ms is already the reduced-eigh floor. Default stays megakernel. Clean K=288 72587us (unchanged). 39/39, CLEAN, stream absent.
